result.summary: The page is generally well-designed, but there are a few visual issues: horizontal carousel items are clipped at the right edge without a clear scroll affordance, and the bottom pizza card is awkwardly cut off by the navigation bar.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel and the category filter chips are clipped at the right edge (e.g., 'Trattoria Piccol...' and a partially visible chip), with no visible scroll indicator or fade-out hint that more content exists horizontally.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle right-edge gradient fade or scroll indicator to signal horizontal scrollability, and ensure card titles truncate gracefully with an ellipsis.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza with -20% badge) is cut off mid-image by the fixed bottom navigation bar, creating an awkward partial view.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content area so the last card is fully visible above the bottom navigation when scrolled to the end.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right has a small red dot indicator that may be difficult to notice and lacks a text alternative or badge count.
issues.suggestion: Provide an accessible label (e.g., 'Notifications, 1 new') and consider a more prominent badge with a count for clarity.
